topic.title: Sports: A volleyball team for girls changes lives
topic.focus: A volleyball team for girls changes lives

candidate_instructions: Read all five sections. Answer Questions 1-5. Follow the stated word limits exactly.

sections.heading: Girls stay home from school
sections.text: In 2013, in a poor town, many girls do not go to school. They work at home or work for money. They do not have time to play or be with friends. Their parents think education is not important for girls. The girls are sad and lonely.

sections.heading: A coach comes to town
sections.text: A coach named Fatima comes to the town. She is a woman volleyball player. She wants to teach girls to play volleyball. She starts a free team. At first, only four girls come. But they love volleyball. They come back the next day.

sections.heading: Families change their minds
sections.text: As more girls play volleyball, their parents see they are happy and healthy. The girls study more too. They have more energy. Their marks go up. Parents realize that sports help their daughters. The parents support the team now.

sections.heading: The team grows strong
sections.text: By 2017, the volleyball team has 30 girls. They practice four times a week. They play matches against other towns. They win many games. The town feels very proud. The girls feel proud of themselves.

sections.heading: More than volleyball
sections.text: Today, the team has 60 girls. Most of them go to school now. Many will go to university. Fatima says volleyball is a door to a better life. The ball and net gave these girls hope. They learned that they can do anything.

passage.full_text:
Paragraph 1 — Girls stay home from school
In 2013, in a poor town, many girls do not go to school. They work at home or work for money. They do not have time to play or be with friends. Their parents think education is not important for girls. The girls are sad and lonely.

Paragraph 2 — A coach comes to town
A coach named Fatima comes to the town. She is a woman volleyball player. She wants to teach girls to play volleyball. She starts a free team. At first, only four girls come. But they love volleyball. They come back the next day.

Paragraph 3 — Families change their minds
As more girls play volleyball, their parents see they are happy and healthy. The girls study more too. They have more energy. Their marks go up. Parents realize that sports help their daughters. The parents support the team now.

Paragraph 4 — The team grows strong
By 2017, the volleyball team has 30 girls. They practice four times a week. They play matches against other towns. They win many games. The town feels very proud. The girls feel proud of themselves.

Paragraph 5 — More than volleyball
Today, the team has 60 girls. Most of them go to school now. Many will go to university. Fatima says volleyball is a door to a better life. The ball and net gave these girls hope. They learned that they can do anything.
